create.name: Karen Noé
create.bio:
Karen Noé is a psychic medium and spiritual teacher based in Waldwick, New Jersey, where she founded the Angel Quest Center more than twenty-five years ago. For most of that time she was known for private readings, booked far ahead; she has now stopped taking new reading clients so that she can give more time to teaching and to a community peace project, though she still holds a small number of energy sessions. Her classes at the centre cover making contact with angels and with people who have died, building everyday intuition, and Reiki at each level.

Her approach is warm and practical. Students pair up for simple intuitive exercises, work with pendulums and oracle cards, and learn to notice signs in daily life. Since 2015 she has shared messages she understands to come from the late author Wayne Dyer and a group of guides she calls the We Guides, gathered in her book We Consciousness. Her other titles include Through the Eyes of Another, on the idea of a life review, and the Angel Quest Oracle deck. She hosts The Angel Quest Show podcast and teaches weekend programmes at Omega Institute, Kripalu and Edgar Cayce's A.R.E., along with free online video programmes made with other afterlife teachers.

books.title: We Consciousness: 33 Profound Truths for Inner and Outer Peace
books.author: Karen Noé
books.description: Thirty-three short teachings that the author presents as messages received from Wayne Dyer and a wider circle of guides after his death. Each chapter offers a principle about oneness and peace with a reflection to carry into the day.

books.title: Through The Eyes of Another: A Medium's Guide to Creating Heaven on Earth by Encountering Your Life Review Now
books.author: Karen Noé
books.description: Drawing on readings in which the departed spoke of regrets, she invites readers to look at their lives from the point of view of the people around them while there is still time to act. Written exercises guide letters of amends and new ways of treating others.

books.title: Angel Quest Oracle
books.author: Karen Noé
books.description: An illustrated card deck with a guidebook, made for asking the angels for direction on everyday questions. The booklet explains several simple spreads and how to prepare the cards before use.

courses.title: Enhancing Your Intuition & Psychic Abilities (Omega Institute)
courses.description: A weekend on Omega's Rhinebeck campus built around partner exercises for reading pictures and objects, sensing auras, using a pendulum and working with oracle cards. Some tapping is used to clear the way for intuitive impressions; all levels are welcome.
courses.price: Member $300 USD, tiered pricing $385 USD or less

courses.title: Awakening to Angelic Guidance and Spirit Communication (Edgar Cayce's A.R.E.)
courses.description: A 75-minute evening webinar hosted online by Edgar Cayce's A.R.E., on hearing guidance from angels and sensing contact from loved ones who have passed. Registration is non-refundable.

courses.title: Classes at the Angel Quest Center
courses.description: Her regular calendar of in-person classes in Waldwick, New Jersey: afternoon sessions on contacting angels and departed loved ones, two-day Reiki levels from first degree to master, group peace meditations and Reiki circles. Places are booked by email.

free_resources.title: Your Daily Concept
free_resources.description: A daily draw on her website that brings up one of the thirty-three teachings from We Consciousness to reflect on. A quick way to sample the book.

free_resources.title: Meet Your Angels (free video programme)
free_resources.description: An hour-long free video hosted by Humanity's Team in which she and three other angel teachers talk about building a relationship with the angels. Free sign-up is required.

free_resources.title: Your Life & the Afterlife (free video programme)
free_resources.description: A free recorded programme with Raymond Moody and Paul Perry on near-death accounts, the life review and living without fear of dying. Hosted by Humanity's Team after a free sign-up.

free_resources.title: Articles & Prayers
free_resources.description: Short prayers and reflections she posts on her site, on themes such as joy, hope and calling on Archangel Michael. Each takes a couple of minutes to read.
